phone: (() => { if (window.__energyShot) return true; window.__energyShot = true; const real = window.fetch.bind(window); const shape = [0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.55, 0.85, 0.9, 0.55, 0.6, 0.9, 1, 0.3, 0.25, 0.95, 1, 0.9, 0.45, 0.2]; window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const res = await real(input, init); const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; if (!url.includes('/api/mix-maps') || !res.ok) return res; const maps = await res.json(); for (const id of JSON.parse(init.body).ids) maps[id] ??= { version: 99, duration: 600, bpm: 120, firstBeat: 0.5, downbeatOffset: 0, gridStable: true, beatConfidence: 0.9, introEnd: 16, outroStart: 560, coldStart: false, coldEnd: false, soundEnd: 599, phraseEnergy: Array.from({ length: 75 }, (_, k) => shape[k % shape.length]) }; return new Response(JSON.stringify(maps), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); }; return true; })()

(async () => { const seek = document.querySelector('[role=slider][aria-label=Seek]'); if (!seek) return false; const key = (target, k) => target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const playing = () => !!document.querySelector('button[aria-label=Pause]'); if (!playing()) key(document.body, ' '); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const left = () => Number(seek.getAttribute('aria-valuemax')) - Number(seek.getAttribute('aria-valuenow')); key(seek, 'Home'); await wait(80); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && left() > 16; i++) { key(seek, 'ArrowRight'); await wait(80); } for (let i = 0; i < 90 && playing() && left() > 7; i++) await wait(100); for (let i = 0; i < 3 && left() > 10; i++) { key(seek, 'ArrowRight'); await wait(80); } if (playing()) key(document.body, ' '); return true; })()
